question: The famous Hindi novel ‘Suni Ghati Ka Suraj’ is written by __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shrilal Shukla**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Shrilal Shukla was a Hindi writer, notable for his satire.
 
• He worked as a **Provincial Civil Services (PCS)** officer for the** state government of Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• Shukla received the **Jnanpith Award**, the** highest Indian literary award, in 2011.**
 
• **Sahitya Akademi Award for his novel Raag Darbari in 1969**.
 
• He received the **Vyas Samman award in 1999 **for the novel Bisrampur ka Sant.
 
• In 2008, he was awarded the **Padma Bhushan** by the President of India for his contribution to Indian literature and culture.
 
• **He has written over 25 books**, including **Raag Darbari, Makaan, Sooni Ghaati Ka Sooraj, Pehla Padaav and Bisrampur Ka Sant.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kedarnath Singh** was an Indian poet 

 
 
• He was awarded the **Jnanpith Award in 2013**, **Sahitya Akademi Award in 1989** in Hindi for his poetry collection, Akaal Mein Saras.
 
 
 
• **Vishnu Prabhakar** was a Hindi writer.
 
 
• He was awarded the **Sahitya Akademi Award in 1993**.
 
• the **Padma Bhushan** by the Government of India in 2004.
 
 
 
• **Mahadevi Varma **was an Indian Hindi-language poet, essayist, story writer and an eminent personality of Hindi literature.
 
 
• She was awarded **Padma Bhushan in 1956**, **Sahitya Akademi in 1979**, **Jnanpith Award in 1982**, and **Padma Vibhushan in 1988**.
 
• **Smriti ki rekhaen, A Pilgrimage to the Himalayas, and Other Silhouettes from Memory, Path ke saathi Companions in Travel, and Mera parivaar.**
